# Spec test vectors

`cluster_hashing.json` and `bls_threshold.json` are copied unmodified from
[ObolNetwork/distributed-validator-specs](https://github.com/ObolNetwork/distributed-validator-specs)
`test_vectors/` at commit `406c832a94d52dc326439514495dd25fb0722db7`. That
repository is MIT licensed (Copyright (c) 2025 Obol Labs, Inc.), which allows
copying them here.

`cluster_hashing.json` holds config, definition and lock hash cases for v1.10.0
cluster files generated by Charon. `test/verification/specVectors.spec.ts` runs
every case.

`bls_threshold.json` holds a threshold-3-of-4 BLS12-381 sharing with Charon's
partial signatures and threshold (Lagrange) aggregates.
`test/exit/blsThresholdVectors.spec.ts` recombines every quorum case.

To update, copy the files from a newer specs commit and change the commit above.
